### 下载 | 包类型 | 平台 | 说明 | 文件 | |--------|------|------|------| | **一键安装包（推荐）** | Windows 7+ x64 | 内嵌完整运行环境，支持一键安装、自动登录与配置 | `QQChatExporter-Installer-v6.4.1.exe` | | **Shell 模式** | Windows x64 | 独立无头 (Headless) 运行环境，适合服务器或自动化部署 | `NapCat-QCE-Windows-x64-v6.4.1.zip` | | **Shell 模式** | Linux x64 | 独立无头 (Headless) 运行环境，适合服务器或 Docker 部署 | `NapCat-QCE-Linux-x64-v6.4.1.tar.gz` | | **Shell 模式（预览）** | macOS Apple Silicon (arm64) | 独立运行环境，首次启动会在本地生成一份专用的 QQ 运行副本，详见 [macOS 使用指南](https://shuakami.github.io/qq-chat-exporter/docs/macos-deploy.html) | `NapCat-QCE-macOS-arm64-v6.4.1.tar.gz` | | **Framework 模式** | Windows | 作为 QQNT 插件运行，与桌面端 QQ 共存 | `NapCat-Framework-QCE-v6.4.1.zip` | | **NapCat 插件商店包** | 跨平台 | 供已有 NapCat 环境的用户直接在插件商店安装 | `napcat-plugin-qce.zip` | > **版本选择指南** > - **一键安装包**：Windows 用户的首选。双击即可自动完成环境配置与登录（支持快捷登录或扫码），安装完毕后将自动唤起 WebUI 面板。 > - **Shell 模式**：独立运行版本，需单独进行 QQ 登录，适用于服务器环境部署及自动化备份需求。macOS 版本目前为预览支持，仅适用于 Apple Silicon（arm64）。 > - **Framework 模式**：作为 QQNT 插件运行，与当前使用的桌面端 QQ 共享登录状态，适合日常使用 Windows 桌面版 QQ 的用户。 > - **NapCat 插件商店包**：适用于已部署 NapCat 环境（含本地安装、Docker 或宿主机部署）的用户。请直接在 NapCat WebUI 的插件商店中搜索安装，**无需手动下载此压缩包**。
Shell 模式使用方法 **完整模式**（需登录 QQ，支持导出新增聊天记录）： - **Windows**：解压后双击运行 `launcher-user.bat` - **Linux**：终端运行 `./launcher-user.sh` - **macOS**：终端运行 `./launcher-user.sh`，详见 [macOS 使用指南](https://shuakami.github.io/qq-chat-exporter/docs/macos-deploy.html) **独立模式**（无需登录 QQ，仅用于浏览已导出的记录文件）： - **Windows**：双击运行 `start-standalone.bat` - **Linux**：终端运行 `./start-standalone.sh` - **macOS**：终端运行 `./start-standalone.sh` 启动后，请在浏览器中访问 `http://localhost:40653/qce`。若使用完整模式，需输入控制台输出的访问令牌 (Access Token) 进行验证。
Framework 模式使用方法 **方式 A：通过 `napiLoader.bat` 运行（推荐）** 此方式独立运行，无需预先安装 LiteLoaderQQNT。 1. 解压下载的 `NapCat-Framework-QCE-v6.4.1.zip` 文件 2. 确保当前已彻底退出正在运行的 QQ 客户端 3. 双击运行 `napiLoader.bat` 脚本 4. 若弹出 QQ 登录界面，请按常规方式完成登录 5. 在浏览器中访问 `http://localhost:40653/qce` **方式 B：通过 LiteLoaderQQNT 加载（仅限特定需求用户）** 此方式要求系统已配置好 LiteLoaderQQNT 环境。 1. 参照 [LiteLoaderQQNT 官方文档](https://liteloaderqqnt.github.io/) 完成前置框架的安装 2. 打开 QQ 设置，确认左侧菜单栏已出现 `LiteLoaderQQNT` 选项 3. 按照 LiteLoaderQQNT 或 NapCat 官方文档中的标准插件安装流程，将本插件部署至对应目录
如何找到访问令牌？ 按下 `Win + R` 键，输入 `%USERPROFILE%\.qq-chat-exporter` 并回车。打开该目录下的 `security.json` 文件，查找 `accessToken` 字段的值即可： ```json { "accessToken": "此处即为你的访问令牌", ... } ```
系统要求 需配合 QQ 客户端版本 34606 及以上使用（推荐版本 9.9.19-34740），[前往下载](https://im.qq.com/)。 - **Windows**：支持 Windows 10/11 x64。如运行报错提示缺少 DLL 文件，请安装 [Visual C++ 运行库](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)。 - **Linux**：支持 Ubuntu 20.04+ / Debian 11+ / CentOS 8+。内置 使用静态 musl 构建，不要求特定 glibc 版本；QQ、NapCat 和注入模块仍需满足各自的系统依赖。 - **macOS**：⚠️ 预览支持，仅限 Apple Silicon（M1 及以上，arm64）。需已安装官方 macOS 版 QQ 与 Xcode 命令行工具（`xcode-select --install`，用于 `codesign`）。首次启动会在本地生成并签名一份专用的 QQ 运行副本，不会修改 `/Applications/QQ.app` 本体；该副本会失去系统 App 沙盒保护，仅用于后台运行 NapCat，详见 [macOS 使用指南](https://shuakami.github.io/qq-chat-exporter/docs/macos-deploy.html)。Intel（x64）Mac 暂未提供官方安装包。
> [!CAUTION] > 本项目完全免费且开源，遵循 GPL-3.0 开源协议。如果您是通过付费渠道获取的本软件，请立即申请退款并进行举报。 [使用文档](https://shuakami.github.io/qq-chat-exporter/) | [问题反馈](https://github.com/shuakami/qq-chat-exporter/issues) | [NapCat 项目](https://github.com/NapNeko/NapCatQQ) ### Contributors

name: v5.1.63
body:
**The macOS keychain helper's lookup paths and tests are correct on Windows CI.** The macOS install locations (the OmO.app runtime and helper copies) are built with POSIX separators on every host, and the #11262 keychain-helper tests use platform-correct paths, so dev's Windows test legs pass again. ([#12690](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12690), part of [#11262](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11262))

Fixed: the first device listing no longer waits about 10 seconds for each signed-out or otherwise unsupported device; the bunshin SDK answers such a device's tool list as empty at once instead of trying to describe it. ([#12680](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12680))

Internal: the vendored bunshin SDK imports its own pinned typebox through omo-senpi's `#bunshin-ts-dep/` imports instead of the bare package name, so senpi's extension registry can no longer hand it a different typebox; no user-visible change. ([#12676](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12676)) ([#12680](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12680))

Thread ops on another device spend fewer relay round trips: the session's attach is kept across ops, and the session's model catalog is held on it, so a model switch to an exact `provider/id` that catalog lists is one `set_model`. A set that may have run is still reported as `idempotency_uncertain`; a refused one re-reads the catalog and answers as a fresh catalog would. Status and transcript reads (`get_state`, `get_messages`) still go to the device every time, because the engine's in-memory state changes without a record on the attach. ([#12672](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12672))

Starting omo no longer reinstalls and restarts a running device service that is only slow to answer: on macOS and Linux a handshake timeout is retried once and then reported as degraded, instead of being treated as a stopped service. ([#12665](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12665))

A message sent to a thread on another device whose engine answers `started` without a turn id (senpi 2026.11.2) is now confirmed with the running turn that `get_state` reports, instead of `idempotency_uncertain`. ([#12660](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12660))

Fixed: closing a thread on another device answers closed instead of uncertain (reply_lost); the close was applied there, but its answer was dropped when the other device ended the session's attachment. ([#12655](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12655))

Fixed: a thread created on another device (thread_create with a device, or a fork there) is named by the id that device lists it by, so reading, messaging, interrupting, switching the model of and closing it work instead of answering session_not_found. ([#12651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12651))

Internal: knip ignores the closed-device-login preload fixture (a --preload test file, nothing imports it); no behavior change. ([#12648](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12648))

**A delegated child whose own model chain has no connected provider now fails with one message that names every model in that chain and the exact fix, instead of an opaque "no available model".** The chain is listed in order with the providers each model needs, the refusal says which providers are not connected, and it names the key the app's Settings editor writes (`categories.<name>.model` for a category, `agents.<name>.model` for an agent), so the parent session can act on the first line instead of retrying a dead binding. The same refusal now covers a lane pinned to a model this machine's registry does not serve, naming the pin and the Settings key. Nothing is substituted and no child is spawned (#12634). ([#12636](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12636))

Internal (tests only): in the omo-native trust-stage TLS probe, a channel that hangs now reports `"timeout"` instead of `false`, so a hang can no longer pass an assertion that expects a TLS rejection. ([#12629](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12629))

**The skills audit's third pass corrects three search commands and one retired category name in the shipped skills (#12525).**

- Three `rg` examples used `rg -iE`. In ripgrep `-E` is `--encoding`, not a pattern-type flag, so the combined form consumes the next argument and the examples did not do what they claimed; they now use `rg -i`.
- One `refactor` guidance line told an agent to fall back from `deep`; that category was split into `deep-low` / `deep-high`, so it now names `deep-high`. ([#12615](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12615))

The `refactor-squad` member prompts keep `team_send_message` + `team_task_update`. The team-mode surface does not expose `task_send` to members, so an earlier draft of this change that rewrote those prompts to `task_send({ to: "lead" })` was wrong and has been reverted here. ([#12615](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12615))

**The skills audit's second pass fixed 24 more places where shipped text disagreed with the code.** The 591-row community audit left 213 rows "partial"; re-reading them against the current sources, plus the 83 reference rows an earlier pass rejected, found these real ones (#12525). ast-grep's examples now put the search path before `--lang` (the helper rejects it after, on the Python 3.9 that stock macOS ships) and describe `$$$` as the lazy matcher ast-grep 0.51 actually is. refactor's ast-grep call sites now say the helper lives in the ast-grep skill, and mass-ulw's graph example uses `new Bun.Glob(...)` instead of a `glob()` the eval kernel does not have. Contradictions inside one surface are gone too: the refactor trigger threshold, browser's WAF routing, ulw-loop's different-goal and self-execution rules, ulw-plan's review-round count and `git` category, ulw-execute's next-wave `amend`, mass-ulw's SDK surface and delivery-gate list, ulw-research's sum context fields, visual-qa's 1920 captures, debugging's post-cleanup evidence line, the accent-on-two-primaries line, and git-master's commit gate versus the workflows that mandate commits. ([#12614](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12614))

**Shipped skills no longer give agents contradictory instructions or describe commands that do not work.** A community audit of the installed skills listed 591 places where two skills, or a skill and the code, disagree; two model families confirmed 118 root causes in this repo, and 117 are fixed (#12525). The ultrawork verification gate now spawns `omo-native-gate-reviewer` instead of `plan-reviewer`, which only reviews plan files. `ulw-execute --make-pr` hands off with the PR URL and merges only when asked, while `--ship` merges. ultrawork, review-work, ulw-execute and ulw-loop now agree on who runs final QA. Skills now use the real `task_send({ to })` shape, `codexGoalJson`, session-scoped `.omo/ulw-loop/<session-id>/` paths, the `lsp_*` tool names and LSP config paths each harness reads, ast-grep commands and rule shapes that ast-grep accepts, and the dag SDK's result envelope. The 250-line split rule, the no-refactor rules for bugfixes and legacy code, the Miri ship gate, the `SIZE_OK` and catch opt-out markers, the ulw-research gate order, and the visual-qa spacing and motion checks no longer contradict each other. ([#12528](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12528))

Computer use is ready for the tool side of a split session: there the audit file goes to the call owner's audit directory on the device, audit records carry the calling session's id, and capture sizing follows the policy sent with the call instead of a model the device does not have; local sessions behave exactly as before. ([#12452](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12452))

**omo-senpi sessions on macOS no longer wake for every file write in HOME.** The config watch added a "a `.omo` may appear here" target for the cwd and every parent up to and including HOME, and a directory watch on macOS receives every change beneath it, so each session handled every write in HOME. Those creation targets now stop at the project root (the first parent holding `.git`), and never include the user config directory's parent (HOME, which the user-config target already covers), any directory that contains it, or the filesystem root. `.omo` directories that already exist are still watched up to HOME; a brand-new `.omo` above the project root is picked up at the next session start. ([#12397](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12397))

**`omo remote attach` forwards every engine command to the remote session and shows the engine's own answer.** The attach view no longer keeps its own list of allowed commands: apart from its handshake, every record the attach TUI sends goes unchanged to the remote device, whose engine decides it. The engine's reply comes back on the same request with its data (a large reply is reassembled and checked first), refusals are shown exactly as the remote side states them, and dialogs and events the engine sends for those commands reach the TUI. The device-service client speaks the current local API: one engine record per command, the delegated command channel, `session.endpoints`, listing rows with kind and parent, and the newer refusal and detach reasons. ([#12261](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12261))

**Desktop memory sync now uses the desktop's account instead of the CLI's.** An engine the desktop launches claims its private `memory-sync` channel at startup, answers with the bootstrap handshake and resolves the sync account through the desktop. A launch without that channel still uses the account `omo login` keeps, and a declared channel that fails reports memory sync as unavailable rather than falling back to CLI credentials. Windows keeps refusing the channel until its pipe-pair path lands. ([#12008](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12008)) ([#12064](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12064))

**Desktop memory sync now attaches on Windows.** The engine's receiver no longer refuses win32: it uses the stream senpi hands over for the declared `memory-sync` channel, which senpi builds from two one-way pipes with their inherit flag already cleared, so the omo side opens no descriptor and spawns nothing. A declared channel that senpi did not adopt still reports memory sync as unavailable, never falling back to CLI credentials. This replaces the Windows refusal that #12008 noted. ([#12025](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12025)) ([#12064](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12064))

**macOS sign-in gets the client side of its signed keychain owner.** New modules check the keychain helper's Developer ID signature (an unsigned or ad-hoc copy is never run), find a verified copy, talk to it under the session lock, and keep one approval per process; sign-in uses them through the keychain store below. ([#11586](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11586), part of [#11262](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11262)) ([#11613](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11613))

**Session locks can be handed to a child process for one call.** `withLock` now gives its callback a lease: `handOver(pid)` makes a child the lock's live holder and `restore()` takes it back, aborting the critical section if the lock changed meanwhile. The macOS keychain helper uses it so no other writer can enter while a keychain change is landing. ([#11578](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11578), part of [#11262](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11262)) ([#11613](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11613))

**macOS sign-in stops asking for keychain access again and again.** With OmO's signed keychain helper installed, the sign-in item moves to the helper the first time a token is used, after which reads need no dialog; an item another app created asks at most once per machine with a plain dialog, never a password dialog. Windows and Linux are unchanged. ([#11589](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11589), part of [#11262](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11262)) ([#11613](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11613))

**`omo doctor` checks the macOS keychain helper.** It reports a missing or damaged helper as a warning (sign-in keeps working through the previous path), and an item the OmO desktop app created is now moved to the helper by the app itself before the CLI would ask for keychain access. ([#11613](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11613), part of [#11262](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11262))

### Changed

- `thread_send` and `thread_handoff` to a session on another device no longer read the session's state before the prompt: the prompt goes out first as a follow-up, and the other device's engine decides whether it starts a turn or waits behind the running one. On today's engines a send takes two sequential relay round trips instead of three: the prompt, then one state read for the started turn's id (idle session) or for the queue position (busy session). A send that starts a turn drops to one round trip once the other device's engine carries senpi#6135 (which fixes senpi#5999). A send that arrives while the other session has claimed a turn but not yet started it now answers `queued` instead of failing as `unsupported`. A steer still reads the session's state first. ([#12679](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12679))
- The `visualize`, `data-scientist` and `frontend` skills now teach how to build a chart page shown inline beside a reply. Figures are computed at their source (SQL in the database the data lives in, DuckDB or Polars over files). An inline chart is drawn in HTML instead of a matplotlib PNG, with `:root { color-scheme: light dark; }` so `light-dark()` fallbacks follow the theme. Bars are HTML elements in a fixed-height container, the first and last axis labels are aligned to the chart edges so neither clips at 390 px, days are cut in the reader's time zone with a partial day marked on its own bar, and one figure is cross-checked against a second source. The preview step now measures each chart's largest bar and legend colours in dark and light at the reply width and 390 px. `frontend` exempts an inline page from its `DESIGN.md` gate, Lighthouse audit and research lanes, which `visualize` already assumed. ([#12612](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12612))
- Internal: the memory component's launch classification is one shared function, so the compiled-executable desktop-sync test exercises the same check omo.js runs. No behavior change. ([#12053](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12053)) ([#12064](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12064))
- Internal: a test now guards that the memory component's shared launch classification module imports nothing, so omo.js's registration half cannot pick up sidecar or private-fds code through it. No behavior change. ([#12064](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12064))

### Fixed

- A thread create or fork whose endpoint lookup on the other device times out or loses its connection is now reported as refused, since nothing was sent, instead of uncertain. A timeout after the command was sent stays uncertain. ([#12650](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12650), part of [#12320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12320))
- `omo login --device` and `omo login --no-browser` now sign in while OmO accounts are still closed, so a computer with no browser or desktop app (for example a server you reach over SSH) can sign in by approving a code on another device. Plain `omo login`, `omo logout` and `omo whoami` still point you to the desktop app. ([#12640](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12640))
- A published omo build can no longer ship the all-zero device-service release key placeholder: the `service-auth` release step now refuses a key set that is not a strict ed25519 set, and a build with no usable key reports the build defect instead of telling a current user to update. ([#12602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12602))
- A received memory-sync key naming a path that exists as a FIFO (or another non-regular file) no longer hangs the cycle: the leaf is refused with a receipt before it is read, so the rest of the batch still applies. ([#12568](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12568), refs [#12158](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12158))
- The memory-core exec-timeout diagnostics case no longer fails under host load: the record's process table is asserted by contract (a table naming the timed-out git, or the `process snapshot failed: <reason>` form when the snapshot itself times out) instead of requiring the table (#12145). ([#12545](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12545))
- The onboarding context no longer embeds the absolute filesystem path of the installed built-in skills root, so the session context is identical for identical builds whatever the install location. The tour now names the built-in `onboarding` skill, which the skills listing resolves by name (#12150). ([#12544](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12544))
- When a user or project skill named `onboarding` shadows the built-in in the skills listing, the tour falls back to the built-in skill's absolute path instead of silently following the shadowing skill; the EQ goldens are re-recorded for the new pointer text (#12544 review). ([#12544](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12544))
- Contributed skills (computer-use, x-search) again yield to any loaded same-name skill, even when the listing carries no path for it, so no duplicate surfaces as a skill-conflict collision; with `onboarding` in `disabled_skills` the tour falls back to the built-in path instead of naming a hidden skill (#12544 review). ([#12544](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12544))
- With only your own memory identity on disk, `ls`, `find`, `grep` and `glob` on `~/.omo`, `~/.omo/memory` or any other folder above the memory area are no longer refused as "belongs to another memory identity", including when Finder or Explorer left a `.DS_Store` or `desktop.ini` there. The guard now refuses a search from above the memory area only while another identity's directory (durable, repo-less, or a live task run) exists there, and the refusal says that one was found without naming it. ([#12301](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12301)) ([#12476](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12476))

### Added

- Thread tools use this device's device service to reach your other devices, on in every session with no setting; a device without the service keeps today's local behavior. ([#12336](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12336), part of [#12320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12320))
- Thread tools take a thread's account-wide alias and a `device` to create a thread on, the groundwork for reaching your other signed-in devices: every call answers exactly as it would on this device, and a Free account gets a clear error. Reaching another device arrives with the device-service wiring that follows. A new `thread_close` ends a session on this device or on another one for every client that holds it; a thread with no live session answers `closed: false`, and a terminal's own session stays with its terminal. ([#12335](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12335), part of [#12320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12320))
- The headless desktop fake backend (`senpi-desktop-backend-fake`) can script window identity and identity changes, key-priming focus reads and focus-record outcomes, hit reads, a timed user-input history with the frontmost pid, an accessibility deadline and dense-tree knob, epoch events, a display change, and a stop marker. Every new hook records a sink op, every field defaults to today's behavior, and a timeline that could never fire (`nth: 0`, a press more than an hour away) is rejected at load. ([#12313](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12313), part of [#12232](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12232))
- The desktop engine protocol gains an opt-in action-report vocabulary on protocol 1, with no version or ABI change. `engine.hello` lists `features: ["action-report"]`, and a session opened with `reportMode: "object"` gets an `ActionReport` from every mutating request. The report says whether input reached the target and whether retrying is safe: one of seven `{delivery, retry}` pairs. Errors from those requests carry the same `disposition`. Sessions that don't opt in see the same replies as before, apart from the new `features` list. The protocol also gains the error codes `AmbiguousTarget`, `CaptureConsentRequired` and `ProtectedProcess`, the `epoch.changed` notification, and optional window-identity and accessibility-evidence fields that later changes will fill in. Frame ids are now unique per engine process, so a frame id from before a session re-open can never match a new capture. ([#12260](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12260), part of [#12234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12234))
- omo Native eval cells can reach this user's machines through the bunshin TypeScript SDK: the plugin bundles `@sisyphuslabs/bunshin-ts` and `@sisyphuslabs/bunshin-ts-relay` (vendored build output pinned per file, not npm dependencies) into `runtime/bunshin-ts/sdk.js`, publishes its directory as `OMO_BUNSHIN_TS_SDK_ROOT` at activation, and the installer requires it. `pickTransport` (`BUNSHIN_TS_TRANSPORT` = `auto`, `relay` or `hub`) uses the local device service when it reports connected; this build bundles no hub transport. Over the relay, one device that is slow, offline or refused on `machine.describe` no longer fails `connect()`, `listMachines()` or `fanout()` for every machine: it is listed `unsupported` with `attention` naming why and after how long, fanout skips it, and the device the cell runs on is listed too (unsupported, since the service runs no machine operation on its own device). A `bunshin` skill pointer and removed-tool hint teach the import. ([#12258](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12258), fixes [#12251](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12251))

name: CC Switch v4.0.27
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.27

本版本让会话管理可以搜索消息正文，新增界面密度和界面缩放设置，模型定价表可以搜索，Grok Build 正在使用的供应商也能打开终端了。Skills 的已安装页重新排了版，供应商图标会跟随深浅色主题。另外修复了配置文件是软链接时被替换成普通文件或写入失败、取消请求后供应商卡在熔断恢复中直到重启、Codex 设置了自定义权限后 plan 模式报错、运行过的 Skill 被误报有更新、Skills 仓库显示 0 个 Skill、Windows 上把 Python 的 `pi.exe` 认成 Pi、模型价格同步超时、打开对话框时窗口拖不动、右键弹出浏览器菜单，以及 Linux 快捷面板显示异常等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.27-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.27-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 搜索会话的消息正文

以前会话管理页的搜索只能找标题、目录和会话 ID，记得聊过什么、却想不起是哪个会话时找不到（[#7896](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7896)、[#7420](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7420)）。

现在可以打开「搜索消息正文」：在页面右上角的「⋯」菜单里打开，或者搜索没有结果时直接点提示里的按钮。打开后，搜索结果会列出命中的正文片段和命中了几条消息。

- 默认关闭。打开后 CC Switch 会在本地为消息正文建立索引，建立期间会显示进度，这时正文结果可能还不全。
- 索引是单独的本地文件 `session-index.db`，不参与云同步，也不进备份；关闭这个开关会删除它。

### 界面密度和界面缩放

「设置 → 通用 → 外观」里新增两项（[#9209](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9209)）：

- **界面密度**：「紧凑」就是原来的尺寸，也是默认值；「舒适」的字号大一档，按钮和输入框更高一些。
- **界面缩放**：90%、100%、110%、125% 四档，也可以按 Ctrl（macOS 上是 ⌘）加 `+`、`-` 调整，按 Ctrl/⌘ 加 `0` 复原。

两项设置只保存在本机，和主题一样。托盘快捷面板始终保持紧凑尺寸。

### 模型定价表可以搜索

模型定价表上方加了搜索框，按模型 ID 或名称筛选（[#9205](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9205)）。按回车会编辑第一个结果；没有匹配的模型时，回车会为输入的模型新增定价。

### Grok Build 打开终端

Grok Build 的供应商卡片也有「打开终端」按钮了（[#9234](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9234)）。Grok CLI 不能只让某一个终端换供应商，所以这个按钮只出现在正在使用的供应商上，打开的终端直接用 CC Switch 管理的这份 Grok 配置；选择跳过权限确认时会加上 `--always-approve`。

---

## 变更

- **Skills 已安装页重新排版**（[#9210](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9210)）：
  - 名称列固定在左侧，窗口窄时各应用的列在它下面横向滚动。
  - 状态和来源筛选移到和「发现」页一样的工具栏里，选中 Skill 后也不会被挡住；批量操作保留更新、卸载和按应用「启用到」/「停用」。
  - 去掉了页头的「N 个可更新」链接，工具栏的「全部更新」已经写了数量；点每行的「可更新」标记就能更新这个 Skill。
  - 每行的「…」菜单保留打开文档、打开目录和卸载；写入失败时，错误信息显示在描述的位置。
- **供应商图标跟随主题**（[#8438](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8438)）：去掉了卡片图标后面固定的白底。单色的深色图标会跟着文字颜色变化，深色模式下也看得清；带深色笔画的多色图标、图片图标和你上传的图标在深色模式下仍然带浅色底。
- **右键不再弹出浏览器菜单**（[#8919](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8919)、[#8921](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8921)）：以前在主窗口和托盘面板里点右键，会弹出浏览器自带的菜单（Windows 上是「后退」「重新加载」「另存为」「打印」等）。现在不会了；输入框、代码编辑器和选中的文字仍然可以右键复制粘贴。
- **熔断日志写明是哪家供应商**（[#9292](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9292)）：熔断器的日志（`CB-001` 到 `CB-006`）都带上了「应用:供应商 id」；熔断器拒绝某家供应商时也会记一行 `FWD-004`，写明供应商名称，不再悄悄跳过。只改了日志，路由和熔断行为不变。
- **预设：** Mistral AI 预设的默认模型改为 `mistral-large-4`（Mistral Medium 3.5 已被 Mistral 宣布弃用），Claude Code、Codex 和 Claude Desktop 的 Mistral AI 预设不再隐藏。Mistral Vibe 套餐和 API 共用额度，「获取 API Key」改为打开 Vibe CLI 的密钥页，免费、订阅和按量付费都能用；添加供应商时搜「Vibe」也能找到它。新增 Genesis（[#9269](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9269)）、TokenPlus（[#9296](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9296)）。已添加的供应商不受影响。

---

## 修复

- **配置文件是软链接时，切换供应商会把它替换成普通文件，Windows 上直接报错**（[#6764](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6764)、[#9283](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9283)）。用 dotfiles 工具或同步文件夹管理 `~/.claude/settings.json`、`~/.codex/config.toml`、`opencode.json` 等文件时，它们通常是软链接。以前写入时会把链接本身替换掉，macOS 和 Linux 上链接变成普通文件、和原文件脱钩，Windows 上报错「原子替换失败」（os error 1464）。现在会写到链接指向的真实文件，链接保持不变。
- **请求中途被取消后，供应商可能一直处在熔断恢复中，直到重启**（[#7206](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7206)、[#9292](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9292)）。熔断恢复期间，熔断器只放一个探测请求过去；如果这个请求还没结束客户端就断开了，名额不会还回去，之后发给这家供应商的请求全被拒绝。现在无论请求怎么结束，名额都会还回去。
- **Codex 设置了自定义权限后，用 plan 模式报错**（[#7349](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7349)、[#7294](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7294)）。较新的 Codex 读取自定义权限时要求 `model_catalog_json` 是绝对路径，以前 CC Switch 写的是文件名，Codex 报 `AbsolutePathBuf deserialized without a base path`。现在写成绝对路径；配置目录在 WSL 里时仍写文件名。
- **运行过一次的 Skill 被显示为「可更新」，点更新会覆盖整个目录**（[#7780](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7780)、[#7772](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7772)）。Python 运行时生成的 `__pycache__` 和 `.pyc` 文件被算进了 Skill 的内容。现在检查更新时忽略这些文件；以前版本记下的旧记录会自动换算，不会因此误报。
- **Skills 仓库显示「识别到 0 个技能」**（[#9273](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9273)）。导入时添加的仓库分支记为 `HEAD`，或者仓库默认分支是 master 却配成了 main 时，数量总是 0。现在按实际读取的分支计数；读取失败的仓库会写明「读取失败」和原因，导入 Skill 新增了仓库后，下次打开会重新读取。
- **Windows 上把 Python 包里的 `pi.exe` 当成 Pi**（[#9267](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9267)）。PyPI 上有一个无关的 `pi` 包会装出 `Scripts\pi.exe`，应用页会把它显示为「无法运行」。Pi 只通过 npm 发布，现在 Python `Scripts` 目录里的 `pi.exe` 不再被识别为 Pi。
- **模型价格同步失败，只提示 `error decoding response body`**（[#9262](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9262)）。网络较慢或经代理时，从 models.dev 下载价格表会在读到一半时超时。现在超时时间从 15 秒放宽到 60 秒，失败时同步状态里会写出真正的原因。
- **添加 DeepSeek Harness 供应商时只提示 `Invalid DeepSeek Harness profile YAML`，不知道是哪个文件**（[#9297](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9297)）。现在报错会写出出错的配置文件路径和 YAML 的具体错误，方便找到文件修复。
- **连通性测试把会重定向的中转站判为不通**（[#9253](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9253)、[#5747](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/5747)）。有的网关在 `/v1` 和 `/v1/` 之间互相重定向，现在测试收到重定向就算连得上。
- **打开对话框时窗口拖不动**（[#9140](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9140)）。现在对话框打开时仍然可以拖动窗口；Windows 和 Linux 上使用应用内窗口按钮时，最小化、最大化和关闭按钮也照常可用。
- **Linux 快捷面板显示异常**：轻量模式下重新打开的面板和窗口渲染出错（[#9233](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9233)、[#9216](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9216)），设置了显示缩放时面板被裁掉一部分（[#9287](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9287)、[#8556](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8556)）。Linux 上的面板改为不透明背景。
- **供应商名称以 emoji 等字符开头、或前面带空格时，没有图标的卡片显示的首字是乱码或空白**（[#8139](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8139)）。
- **一键导入链接的风险提示漏判了内嵌 IPv4 地址的 IPv6 地址**（[#8127](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8127)）。这类地址现在按它实际指向的 IPv4 地址判断是否为本机或内网。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo（界面密度和缩放、模型定价表搜索、Grok Build 打开终端、Skills 已安装页、对话框拖动、重定向中转站）、@Owlbay（消息正文搜索、供应商图标跟随主题、Linux 快捷面板）、@xue-ding-e（消息正文搜索）、@allenxu09（供应商图标跟随主题）、@SailingLoong（Codex plan 模式报错）、@rollroyces（Skill 误报有更新）、@jzcangshu（右键浏览器菜单）、@Railgun-wiki（Linux 快捷面板缩放）、@subbareddypalagiri（图标首字、一键导入风险提示）、@lxw665（Genesis 预设）、@XiaoqiangPei（TokenPlus 预设）的贡献。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@guokun666、@742369675-coder（Claude Desktop 的一键导入链接）、@funkpopo（DeepSeek Harness 配置目录）、@SailingLoong（网关拒收图片时的降级）。

感谢 @Joyyi-11、@BennettChina、@Ming-Sir-69、@xjtusjtu、@zhengguilin、@YongmaoLuo、@dujunily、@sancodeee、@yinshuang007、@1974471409、@zjking、@WesternGua、@libcyz、@SuFangzheng 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: v2.2.6
body:
### Highlights

- **Shared MCP Connections**: Turn on pooling for an MCP server to share one connection across projects with the same setup, so you run fewer processes and start faster. ([#61185](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61185))
- **GUI Plugin Themes and New Slots**: GUI plugins can now add color themes, render or add actions to code blocks, and use native settings and menu components. ([#61485](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61485), [#61533](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61533), [#61527](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61527), [#61509](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61509))
- **Mobile Composer Dock**: On phones and tablets, composer actions now sit in a touch dock above the keyboard with larger buttons. ([#61773](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61773))
- **Scripted Runs in Worktrees**: Run `opencode run -w` to start the session in a new git worktree, or `--worktree=<name>` to name it. ([#60712](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60712))
- **Automatically Archived Runs**: Add `--archived` to `opencode run` to keep scripted and CI sessions out of your inbox and session lists. ([#61270](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61270))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Added opt-in MCP connection sharing through `pool: true`. ([#61185](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61185))
- Added `opencode run --archived`, which creates the session already archived so scripted and CI runs stay out of the inbox, home, and session lists. Archived sessions are also hidden from the TUI session list and skipped by `--continue`. ([#61270](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61270))
- Added `opencode run --worktree` (`-w`), which starts the session in a new git worktree. Use `--worktree=<name>` to choose the worktree name. It cannot be combined with `--continue` or `--session`. ([#60712](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60712))
- Added provider- and model-specific session warming settings, including an `interval: "auto"` mode based on cache TTL. ([#60025](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60025), [#60969](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60969))
- Added the `websearch.use` policy action and switches for enabling all feature flags with `OPENCODE_FLAGS=all` or `experimental.all_flags`. ([#61557](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61557), [#61826](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61826))
- Added an experimental bytecode VM for Code Mode. It is off by default; turn it on with `experimental.codemode_vm: true` or `OPENCODE_FLAGS=codemode_vm`. ([#62358](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62358))
- Added support for Microsoft Store installations of PowerShell 7 on Windows. ([#61952](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61952))
- Added Azure Messages support for Foundry Claude models. ([#60934](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60934))

#### Bug fixes

- `opencode run` now waits for the background shell commands, subagents, and image jobs that its prompt started, then lets the model respond to their results before it exits. While it waits, it prints `waiting for N background job(s)` (a `background_wait` event with `--format json`). There is no time limit: a job that never exits, such as a dev server or file watcher, keeps the run open until you press Ctrl+C or send SIGTERM, so set a timeout on CI jobs. ([#60699](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60699), [#61911](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61911))
- Reworked noninteractive `opencode run` execution so arguments, cancellation, compiled WebSocket upgrades, and service shutdown complete reliably. SIGTERM now cancels the session and its background jobs and exits with code 143. ([#61911](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61911), [#61721](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61721), [#61518](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61518), [#61564](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61564))
- Serve file reads and media from the server API as sandboxed downloads, and refuse cross-site browser navigations and requests from disallowed origins to `/api/*`, so a file in your project cannot run scripts on the server's origin. ([#62422](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62422))
- Webfetch and Code Mode `fetch` now reject URLs that contain credentials and ignore the `#fragment` when matching permission rules, and Code Mode `fetch` checks every redirect against your webfetch rules. ([#60502](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60502), [#61701](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61701), [#62373](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62373))
- Ask for `external_directory` permission before `session_move` leaves the current project. ([#62204](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62204))
- Wait up to 2 seconds for MCP servers that are still connecting before a model call, so tools from servers that connect quickly reach the first prompt and `opencode run`. Also expand `~` in local MCP working directories, handle legacy stdio servers, and send `logo_uri` during dynamic registration. ([#60490](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60490), [#61496](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61496), [#61817](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61817), [#59031](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59031))
- Time out OpenCode Console config requests after 5 seconds, so startup no longer hangs when the Console accepts the connection but never answers. ([#62404](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62404))
- Retry provider requests while their host is unreachable and recover prematurely ended Cohere streams. ([#61880](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61880), [#61184](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61184))
- Keep legacy custom providers whose models set only part of `limit`, such as only `limit.context`, instead of dropping the whole provider without an error. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62240](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62240))
- `opencode acp` now removes a session that a client creates with `session/new` and closes without prompting, so IDE integrations no longer leave empty sessions behind. ([#62189](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62189))
- Prevent repeated zsh `q` flags from freezing shell permission scanning. Thanks @yangguan-xue. ([#60791](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60791))
- Allow npm upgrade install scripts again. Thanks @renatomoselli. ([#51554](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/51554))

### TUI

#### Improvements

- Added **Scroll on send** in Settings. Choose **Keep** (`session.submit_scroll: "keep"`) to retain your reading position after submitting a prompt. ([#61460](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61460))

#### Bug fixes

- Allow Ctrl+Z to suspend OpenCode while a form or dialog is open. ([#62118](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62118))
- Keep focus on an open dialog when a question arrives and contain plugin dialogs that throw during rendering. ([#60365](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60365), [#62110](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62110))
- Show an error when Ctrl+V cannot read the clipboard. Thanks @jimmyallinai. ([#61094](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61094))
- Prevent session titles containing newlines from crashing the TUI. Thanks @vishalshekhar. ([#57523](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/57523))
- Improved message spacing and prevented older history from flashing while scrolling. ([#62104](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62104), [#59236](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59236))
- Jump to the first or last message with Home, End, and Ctrl+G in subagent sessions. Thanks @ricky9408. ([#60817](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60817))
- Keypad Home, End, Page Up, and Page Down now navigate the transcript like the main keys in terminals that use the kitty keyboard protocol. Thanks @argszero. ([#59770](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59770))
- `opencode mini` now uses the agent colors from your config. Thanks @ferdinandyb. ([#62067](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62067))
- Return to the `/mcp` list after signing in to an MCP server, with that server still selected. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62245](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62245))
- Allow favoriting models with Ctrl+F in `/models` when they come from a provider declared in config or an add-on instead of a saved connection. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62244](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62244))

### Desktop

#### Improvements

- Added a mobile composer dock for touch devices, with 44px action targets and predictable multiline input. ([#61773](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61773))
- Added close-other-tabs and close-tabs-after actions to the tab menu. ([#61631](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61631))
- Added unread-session grouping in Inbox and failed-run indicators on tabs. ([#61691](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61691), [#62077](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62077))
- MCP sign-in now accepts a pasted redirect URL when automatic redirection is unavailable. ([#61706](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61706))
- Markdown file previews now display frontmatter as a properties list. ([#60333](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60333))
- The command palette shows a date instead of "Xd ago" for sessions 7 or more days old. Hover the time to see the full date and time. ([#62314](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62314))
- Prompt history now keeps up to 200 prompts. Past the newest 100, only prompts without attachments are kept. ([#62313](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62313))

#### Bug fixes

- Improved prompt submission and timeline behavior during loading, reconnects, retries, scrolling, compaction, and optimistic delivery. ([#62025](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62025), [#62037](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62037), [#61932](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61932), [#62151](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62151))
- Surface loading and offline failures in review previews, file search, details, Word pages, and review diffs instead of showing empty or clean results. ([#62114](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62114), [#61862](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61862))
- Fixed provider connection, MCP sign-in, settings, and plugin loading flows that could become stuck after failures. ([#62102](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62102), [#61917](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61917), [#61580](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61580))
- Preserve drafts, focus, caret position, queued prompts, and selected terminal tabs across failed or concurrent transitions. ([#61579](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61579), [#61969](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61969), [#61852](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61852))
- Restart plugins after failed update handoffs and recover the renderer, storage, event stream, and background-service connection from transient failures. ([#61649](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61649), [#61908](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61908), [#61804](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61804), [#61748](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61748))
- Corrected V2 file labels and mention syntax. Thanks @velmet and @cheapredwine. ([#55677](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/55677), [#60737](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60737))
- Attach only the `@mentions` in a line comment that match an existing file or folder, so a comment such as `Check @here` no longer fails the send. Render partial diffs in the review pane when it shows all lines, instead of a blank pane. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62242](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62242), [#62241](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62241))
- Keep pasted images sendable after the clipboard tool deletes its temporary file. Thanks @lfscqk67. ([#62057](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62057))
- While an input method is composing text, Escape, Enter, and Tab go to the input method instead of stopping the agent or picking a suggestion. ([#62318](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62318))
- Fixed padding in the WSL distribution picker, the position of worktree and branch labels in Home search results, and the selected ring on the Interface layout setting. Thanks @inuyume. ([#53676](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/53676), [#62317](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62317), [#62309](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62309))

### SDK

#### Improvements

- Added `client.experimental.job.list()` and its Effect equivalent for listing background shell, subagent, and image jobs, with session, descendant, kind, and status filters. ([#60698](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60698))
- Server embedders can provide a custom `fetch` implementation for OpenCode HTTP, model, web, and remote MCP traffic. ([#61582](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61582))

### Extensions

#### Improvements

- Added `CodeBlock` and `CodeBlockAction` GUI registries for custom fenced-code rendering and actions. ([#61533](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61533))
- GUI plugins can contribute themes through the `Theme` registry. ([#61485](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61485))
- Added `ctx.ui.Select`, settings layout components, and menu-row components for native-looking plugin interfaces. ([#61527](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61527))
- GUI plugin side panels can set, read, and persist their preferred width. ([#61509](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61509))

#### Bug fixes

- Isolated plugin dialogs, Markdown renderers, terminal views, lazy chunks, and artifact viewers so failures do not take down their host surface. ([#62110](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62110), [#62123](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62123), [#61993](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61993))

name: v2.14.2 — Organic short-form growth for apps and products: earn posting volume with views, and pick…
body:
Organic short-form growth for apps and products: earn posting volume with views, and pick formats by what they produce.

- **social** (2.4.1 → 2.4.2): the short-form guide replaces the flat "2-4 posts a day to grow" table with a staged cadence (warm up, 1 thoughtful post a day until posts clear a view floor, up to 3 a day spaced 3-4 hours apart, then another warmed account rather than more posts per account, and a pause rule for stalled accounts). Adds a new-account warm-up checklist with compliance guardrails (brand-affiliated accounts, no bought or automated accounts, disclosed paid creators), a winning-format search that logs tests and calls winners on signups or installs rather than views, how to measure what views produce, and post-once-publish-everywhere.
- **reverse-engineer-marketing** (1.1.0 → 1.1.1): the mobile apps pack adds account networks as a signal (unbranded niche accounts that share the app's link, with first post dates, cadence, and the format repeated across them) and a play for remaking their winning format.
- **marketing-loops** (1.7.0 → 1.8.0): new format-finding loop that reads posts at 48 hours, applies the staged cadence per account, names the winning format by signups, and sends cadence increases and new accounts to a human. The catalog now has 60 loops.
- **Tools**: new [Post Bridge](tools/integrations/post-bridge.md) integration guide (REST API, official MCP and CLI, multi-account posting, per-post daily view analytics), listed alongside Buffer; the Social Media recommendation in the registry is now neutral.

name: v0.13.0
body:
The latest release of Lore, Epic Games' next-generation open source version control system.

[Quickstart](https://epicgames.github.io/lore/tutorials/quickstart/) | [Design](https://epicgames.github.io/lore/explanation/system-design/) | [Documentation](https://epicgames.github.io/lore/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/E4SFJKRPbg)

## Quick Install

Windows
```
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS / Linux
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

## Release Notes

Changes since v0.12.0.

### Breaking changes

* `lore.user.v1`: `UserService` partition RPCs are replaced by `RepositoryRegistryService`; with `user_url` set, the directory there must serve it before `lore-server` is upgraded
* `lore-server` authorization: changing a partition needs `write`, changing branch protection needs `owner` or `admin` (or `write` for the creator), and presigned URLs need `presign` instead of `is_service_account`
* Server hooks: `Hook::pre_handler` is now `async`; a timeout fails the request with `UNAVAILABLE` instead of `INTERNAL`
* Clients on a `lores://` remote refuse advertised endpoints that don't authenticate the server, such as `lore://`
* Ignore and view rules match paths as `.gitignore` does: `**` and character classes stay within one path component
* `.loreignore` applies only to untracked paths, so changes to committed files it matches are reported and staged ([ADR-00027](https://github.com/EpicGames/lore/blob/main/docs/developing/decisions/00027-ignore-filter-applies-to-untracked-paths-only.md))
* `lore sync --reset` and `lore branch switch --reset` leave untracked files in place, and `lore reset` no longer consults the ignore file
* A failed link push exits with its error's code instead of 255, or the new code 52 (`LinkDivergent`)
* File names Windows reads as something else, such as `C:`, `file.` or `file::$DATA`, are refused on every platform

### Features

* Progress is printed every 30 seconds when stdout is not a terminal (`LORE_PROGRESS_INTERVAL`)
* `lore auth login --reuse-session` reuses a still-valid login
* The `AuthUserToken` event reports when the stored OIDC session expires
* `[sync] prefetch_tree = true` fetches a sync's tree in bulk requests
* `lore-server`: `server.trust_unsigned_identity` names callers in locks and notifications on servers without auth
* `lore-server`: the lock service's `Query` can be forwarded to a remote server (`lock_query`)
* `lore-server`: configurable QUIC initial congestion window (`initial_cwnd_bytes`) and, on Linux, several UDP sockets per endpoint (`num_sockets`)

### Fixes & Improvements

* Much faster scans under large views and ignore files (157 s to 11 s for a 6,342-rule view over 450,000 files)
* Whole-directory adds and deletes in a sync run on every core, and large syncs use less memory
* Windows: fewer file system calls for antivirus and other filter drivers to inspect
* Written files take fewer stats and only change executable bits where needed
* Throttled storage copies back off and retry instead of uploading the full payload
* gRPC over TLS falls back to bundled root certificates when the OS store has none
* Sparse views: excluded directories are skipped by clone, diff and scans, and created only for content the view keeps
* Scans and staging add or delete excluded directories only along with content below them
* Directory-only rules such as `Intermediate/` apply to directories only
* `lore status` lists and `lore unstage` takes back staged changes to ignored paths
* Fixed `lore stage --scan` taking in some ignored files under nested re-inclusions
* Fixed scans keeping untracked entries an ignore rule later excludes
* Fixed `lore stage` taking in every file of a new directory where only some were marked
* Merges keep both a move and an edit of the same file, and report conflicts for paths with `[` or `]`
* Case-only renames commit without `--force`
* Fixed deleted directories left behind when a file in them is spelled in another case
* Merges under a sparse view show up in diffs, file history and `lore link list`
* Fixed several staging, unstaging and reset problems with links and layers
* `lore reset` keeps nested repositories
* Fixed a failed removal on Unix making files world-writable; removals no longer follow symbolic links
* Lore service closes its SWFS mounts on exit, and on Windows a second service no longer takes over the socket
* `lore repository instance prune` keeps unreadable instances on file systems such as Btrfs
* Revisions named by number resolve faster, and common-ancestor lookups no longer return a too-new revision
* `lore-server`: faster branch push and BranchList, and the legacy `BranchPush` handles deleted branches as v1 does
* `lore-server`: replicated store requests no longer stall during a client refresh, and composite reads fall back to the durable store sooner
* `lore-aws`: shared DynamoDB reads, and batch reads back off on unprocessed keys
* `lore-server`: more branch push metrics under `lore.branch_push`

## Release Assets

> [!IMPORTANT]
These can be downloaded under the "Assets" section below.

### Installer
- `lore-setup` - Lore CLI Windows installer

### Binaries
- `lore` - Lore CLI
- `loreserver` - Lore Server
- `liblore` - Lore Shared Library

### Headers
- `lore.h` - Single header for `liblore` (packaged with `liblore`)

### Supported Platforms
- Windows x86_64
- macOS AArch64
- Linux x86_64
- Linux AArch64
- Linux AArch64, optimized for Graviton/Neoverse 512-tvb

## Lore Desktop Client

> [!IMPORTANT]
Lore Desktop Client is available as binaries only, download the installer for your platform here:

- Windows: [Lore-Desktop-Setup-x64.exe](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/Lore-Desktop-Setup-x64.exe)
- macOS: [Lore-Desktop-arm64.dmg](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/Lore-Desktop-arm64.dmg)
- Linux (Ubuntu 24.04): [lore-desktop_amd64.deb](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/lore-desktop_amd64.deb)
- Linux (AppImage): [Lore-Desktop-x86_64.AppImage](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/Lore-Desktop-x86_64.AppImage)

##  ⬇️ Open Source Lore Assets Below ⬇️

name: Sub2API 0.2.20
body:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

新增基于 OAuth 授权的管理 MCP 接口，并完善管理员密钥的细粒度权限；同时全面治理网关请求体内存与读写超时，提升高并发下的稳定性。

## 新增功能

- 管理 MCP：新增 OAuth 认证的管理 MCP 接口及前端授权确认/连接管理页面，需显式配置 MCP_PUBLIC_URL 才会启用（默认关闭）
- 管理员密钥：补全权限项（统计、OpenAI OAuth、邀请等）与中英文权限展示，新增需输入确认文字才能开启的「全权兼容模式」
- 注册邮箱精确黑名单：支持批量粘贴（上限 20000 条），按收件箱身份匹配 Gmail 点号/+后缀变体，保存时可批量禁用命中的已注册用户
- OpenAI 生图账号支持按 1K/2K/4K 尺寸档位分流，未指定尺寸时按档位偏好逐层选号
- 新增 gateway.disable_openai_transport_error_cooldown 开关，可关闭 OpenAI 传输错误冷却
- Antigravity 账号用量显示每个配额组真实的 5 小时与每周窗口，Pro 套餐的独立 Argon 配额单独成行
- Antigravity INTERNAL 500 账号惩罚档位可通过环境变量配置

## 优化改进

- 网关请求体内存预算、上游/下游读写超时与后台任务全面加上限，减少慢连接和大请求对实例的影响
- 网关热路径减少 JSON 拷贝与重复解析（thinking 过滤、Codex 引导/压缩判断、Gemini 流增量等），RPM 覆盖与分组隐私门控不再每请求查库
- 请求体读取失败按超时（408）、客户端断开（499）、截断、解码错误分类返回，并记录不含内容的诊断日志
- 打通 GPT Image 2.6 原生图片链路，保留 complexity 与原生编辑选项
- Antigravity 连接测试改为发送管理员填写的提示词并返回模型真实回复
- Kimi 并发上限 403 改用短冷却，不再长时间下线账号
- Antigravity 图像模型的 INTERNAL 500 只冷却该模型，不再连带整个账号进入惩罚
- 用户使用记录导出每页 1000 条，遇面板限流 429 按 Retry-After 等待后重试
- Codex 密钥导出与 CC Switch 导出默认模型统一改为 GPT-6.1 Sol，并启用实时联网搜索、保留图片配置
- GPT-6.1 Terra 使用官方 Codex 描述（上下文窗口 500k），校验 effort 与兼容缓存键
- 错误透传规则可覆盖内置的请求体过大 413
- MCP 客户端 ID 过长时前端截断显示，MCP 关闭时隐藏入口

## Bug 修复

- 修复 Anthropic setup-token 账号在无 5h 限制时丢失每周用量的问题
- 修复长会话中 cyber transcript 误拦截的问题（#8519）
- 修复异步生图任务因请求体内存预算被提前释放而全部 503 的问题
- 修复 Bedrock EventStream 帧长度未校验即分配内存的问题
- 修复 Gemini 上游 SSE 行与 Antigravity 非流式响应读取无上限的问题
- 修复补丁预算在 failover 中累积导致误拒绝的问题
- 修复 OpenAI OAuth 透传对 codex 模型空 instructions 本地返回 403 的问题，response.instructions 回显按客户端原值还原
- 修复非流式 /v1/responses 在上游返回 incomplete/cancelled 或缺少 Content-Type 的 SSE 时未返回 JSON 的问题
- 修复 WebSocket HTTP 桥接未应用 Codex 指纹收敛的问题
- 修复 OpenAI WS 透传部分轮次未记录首 token 时间的问题
- 修复强制路由模式下仍发起 responses 探测的问题
- 修复生图尺寸溢出选号时错误改写会话粘性绑定的问题
- 修复 GPT Image 账号生图测试参数错误的问题
- 修复 API Key 校验时客户端断开或密钥格式错误被报告为 500 的问题
- 修复 Grok Voice 请求体读取失败被误报为 400 并回显原始 socket 错误的问题
- 修复 Grok 委派消息输入在 Responses 中未规范化的问题
- 修复 apicompat 转换丢失缓冲 reasoning 内容、完成响应丢失消息内容字段的问题
- 修复 Gemini 原生 function response 中工具媒体丢失的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 直连 Gemini 流式响应异常、responseJsonSchema 未改写为 responseSchema 的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 转发时残留旧系统身份、误删携带任务内容的身份前导的问题
- 修复 Cloudflare REST messages 请求携带 beta 查询参数的问题

## 破坏性变更

- 请求体内存预算：新增 security.request_body_memory_budget_bytes（默认 1GiB），超出时返回 503 + Retry-After；设为 0 可禁用
- 读写超时：新增 security.request_body_read_timeout_seconds 与 downstream_write_timeout_seconds（默认均 120 秒，0 禁用），上传单次读取停滞超时返回 408
- 客户端断开后的上游 drain 窗口改为有上限，超时截断会影响该请求的计费口径；会话缓存改为有界
- GPT-6.1 Terra：OAuth/setup-token 订阅请求超过 272k 不再收取长上下文附加费；Codex 窗口升至 500k 后 API Key 请求越过 272k 更频繁，按 2x/1.5x 计费；Terra 兼容路径的 minimal effort 改为返回 400
- 新增数据库迁移 249_mcp_oauth.sql，升级时自动执行

## 升级指南

- 容器内存较小或并发长上下文请求较多的部署，请按实际情况调整 security.request_body_memory_budget_bytes，详见 deploy/EDGE_SECURITY.md
- 如需启用管理 MCP，配置 MCP_PUBLIC_URL（需 HTTPS，路径为 /api/v1/mcp）



---

## 📥 Installation

**Docker:**
```bash
# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.20

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.20
```

**One-line install (Linux):**
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash
```

**Manual download:**
Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

## 📚 Documentation

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api)
- [Installation Guide](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/blob/main/deploy/README.md)

name: v1.3.10
body:
[English](#en-v1.3.10) | [中文](#cn-v1.3.10)

Highlights

- Added **OpenAI Codex subscription access** with device-code sign-in and dynamic model selection, plus a separate **ChatGPT Native OAuth** provider. Native OAuth availability depends on account eligibility; existing Codex sign-in remains independent. - Added **Codex image generation** as a material source. Text and image generation can share the application's Codex login, and generated images support the existing static and slow zoom effects. - Added **Infistar and Jalapeno Cloud** for LLM and video generation, alongside **Runcrate, CloudGPU, and cheapaimodel** LLM providers. - Improved **long-running video generation feedback** with generation stages, elapsed time, and polling status. Task tracking survives page refreshes and temporary query failures, with protection against duplicate submissions. - Simplified **provider settings and selection** in the WebUI, making configured services easier to find and switch between. - Added **Arabic-script subtitle shaping**, including connected letters, right-to-left layout, mixed-script font fallback, and glyph-aware wrapping and backgrounds. - Made **slow image zoom smoother** with sub-pixel rendering, eliminating visible stepping and wobble. - Added Indonesian to script-language choices and refined the Indonesian interface translations. ## Fixes and Improvements - Fixed long Edge TTS narration timing out because of unnecessary delays between streamed chunks. Added support for Edge voices with script subtags and clearer Gemini empty-audio diagnostics. - Removed emoji from narration and burned-in subtitles, and clarified that Gemini and MiMo TTS do not use the voice-speed setting. - Improved subtitle splitting around clock times, full-width numbers, dates, abbreviations, names, and Chinese and Japanese punctuation. Added sentence splitting for Thai and Lao scripts. - Preserved the original timed transcription when subtitle correction cannot align the full script. Fixed empty-string and Unicode length-expansion cases in subtitle similarity scoring. - Preserved combining marks in multilingual social hashtags, excluded emoji marks, and recognized Chinese and Japanese hashtag separators. - Kept existing script and keywords when AI generation fails, displayed an actionable error, and avoided requesting keywords after script generation has already failed. - Preserved the position of repeated topics during script-order stock-material matching, repaired corrupt video caches, and added clearer Pexels and Coverr search-failure logs. - Stopped console keystrokes from prematurely ending or stalling FFmpeg clip concatenation. Fixed render-output synchronization on Windows and big-endian grayscale TIFF brightness. - Improved Windows startup from paths containing special characters, from other working directories, and with LAN listening enabled. Fixed redirected console logs and preserved Windows paths and non-breaking spaces when saving configuration. - Shared Redis task-concurrency limits across workers, with atomic slot reservation, lease renewal, and queued-task recovery. - Improved subtitle-font error messages, API enum defaults, and ChatGPT/Codex sign-in diagnostics. Clarified Docker configuration setup and recovery from an accidentally mounted `config.toml` directory. - Updated CPU-container dependencies to address fixable security findings and added container vulnerability scanning. Expanded regression coverage and corrected Windows-specific path assertions. ## What's Changed - Codex subscription provider — @Hackerprod in [#1715](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1715). - ChatGPT Native OAuth provider — @Quiyyy in [#1716](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1716). - Codex image material source — @Hackerprod in [#1719](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1719). - Infistar LLM and video providers — [ebb0e28](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/ebb0e283) / [fddd3d6](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/fddd3d6a). - Jalapeno Cloud LLM and video support — [66e41b0](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/66e41b0f). - Runcrate LLM provider — @heydryft in [#1713](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1713). - CloudGPU LLM provider — @cursoragent in [#1730](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1730). - cheapaimodel LLM provider — @nicho810 in [#1757](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1757). - Video-generation progress and task tracking — [950ba89](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/950ba898). - Simplified provider settings — @Hackerprod in [#1723](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1723). - Arabic subtitle shaping — @DrEssam97 in [#1698](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1698). - Smooth image zoom — @kindsr in [#1767](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1767). - Indonesian language improvements — @mteguhfh in [5c1268b](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/5c1268b5) / [89c7e41](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/89c7e418). - 重点更新

- 新增 **OpenAI Codex 订阅接入**，支持设备码登录和动态模型选择；另提供独立的 **ChatGPT 原生 OAuth 接入**。原生授权取决于账号资格，与已有 Codex 登录相互独立。 - 新增 **Codex 图片素材来源**，文案与生图可复用本应用的 Codex 登录，生成的图片支持现有的静止和缓慢放大效果。 - 新增 **Infistar 和 Jalapeno Cloud 大模型及视频生成服务**，以及 **Runcrate、CloudGPU、cheapaimodel** 大模型服务。 - 完善**长时间视频生成的进度反馈**，显示生成阶段、已用时间和轮询状态；刷新页面或查询短暂失败后可继续跟踪任务，并增加重复提交保护。 - 简化 WebUI 的**服务商设置与选择**，便于查找和切换已经配置的服务。 - 新增**阿拉伯语文字字幕整形**，支持字母连写、从右到左排版、混合文字字体回退，以及按实际字形计算换行和背景。 - 改善**图片缓慢放大的流畅度**，通过亚像素渲染消除明显的步进和抖动。 - 新增印尼语脚本语言选项，并完善印尼语界面翻译。 ## 修复与改进 - 修复 Edge TTS 因流式数据处理延迟导致长文案配音超时的问题；支持带脚本子标签的 Edge 音色，并补充 Gemini 返回空音频时的原因提示。 - 从配音和烧录字幕中清理 emoji，明确提示 Gemini、MiMo TTS 不使用配音语速设置。 - 改善时间、全角数字、日期、缩写、人名及中日文标点附近的字幕断句；补充泰语、老挝语按句间空格拆分的处理。 - 字幕校正无法对齐完整文案时保留原始转写时间轴；修复相似度计算遇到空字符串或特殊 Unicode 字符时除零、返回负值的问题。 - 保留多语言社交标签中的组合字符，排除 emoji 标记，并识别中文、日文标签分隔符。 - AI 文案或关键词生成失败时保留已有内容并显示错误；文案生成失败后不再继续请求关键词。 - 修复按脚本顺序匹配库存素材时重复主题丢失位置的问题；修复损坏的视频缓存，并补充 Pexels、Coverr 搜索失败的具体原因。 - 避免控制台按键提前结束或阻塞 FFmpeg 片段拼接；修复 Windows 渲染文件同步，以及大端灰度 TIFF 图片亮度问题。 - 改善 Windows 下特殊字符路径、其他工作目录和局域网监听场景中的启动兼容性；修复日志重定向，并在保存配置时保留 Windows 路径和不换行空格。 - 统一多个工作进程的 Redis 任务并发限制，支持原子占用执行名额、续期和排队任务恢复。 - 改善字幕字体错误提示、API 枚举默认值和 ChatGPT/Codex 登录诊断；补充 Docker 配置说明，以及误将 `config.toml` 挂载为目录时的恢复提示。 - 更新 CPU 容器依赖，修复可解决的安全扫描问题，并增加容器漏洞扫描；完善回归测试，修正 Windows 路径断言误报。 ## 主要变更 - [#1715](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1715)：Codex 订阅接入，感谢 @Hackerprod。 - [#1716](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1716)：ChatGPT 原生 OAuth 接入，感谢 @Quiyyy。 - name: v15.11.1
body:
## Pro sign-in works again

Signing in to cmem.ai Pro from the plugin returned a 500 error on every fresh plugin install. The plugin's install did not include `better-auth`, and its tables were never created. The plugin now ships `better-auth` and `@better-auth/api-key` as dependencies and creates the auth tables the first time they are needed (#5455, thanks @0xABCD01).

## Fixes

- **Worker:** when a run pauses after a transport, rate-limit or similar abort, it now releases its claims, so the paused session no longer holds pending work that can never expire (#5457, thanks @akashpandey).
- **Worker:** an over-budget condense reply is clamped to the budget instead of being thrown away (#5452, thanks @xunguangzlj-cloud).
- **Worker:** retry-without-reasoning now recognizes OpenCode Go's "cannot be represented" error wording (#5439, thanks @akashpandey).
- **Hooks:** the Stop hook reads Claude Code's `last_assistant_message` directly and skips reading the transcript (#5449, thanks @xunguangzlj-cloud).
- **Context:** the OAuth hint and gateway fallback notice are reserved before the context is fitted, so SessionStart context stays under Claude Code's 10,000-character limit (#5441, thanks @liuyinchu).
- **Codex:** stale app-server child processes are recycled on the auth recovery probe (#5438, thanks @akashpandey).
- **Installer:** the Goose YAML config is written atomically, so an interrupted install or uninstall can no longer leave a truncated config.yaml (#5442, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **Tests:** the sync matrix waits for the page body before reading it, fixing a browser readiness race (#5448).

## Also in this release

- **My Work:** the scheduled refresh check interval is now a setting (#5437, thanks @weirui828).
- **Docs:** one story across the README and docs: your coding agent forgets between sessions, Claude-Mem remembers (#5447).
- **Docs:** README translations keep fenced code examples and single-quoted links intact (#5458, thanks @Afloat16).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.11.0...v15.11.1

name: v15.11.0
body:
# Installer screen telemetry and runtime fixes

Claude-Mem now records progress through the local setup screens, so the admin can show where setup continues, goes back, encounters a known error, or has no recorded next step.

- Track the nine actual setup screens: Scan, Reveal, Choose memory, Review savings, Checkout, Finish setup, Import history, Launch, and Workspace.
- Count each rendered screen visit separately. Returning to a screen creates a new visit; failed hand-offs do not become successful forward transitions.
- Preserve the real setup branches. At Home and existing Pro configurations skip checkout, history import returns to Finish setup, and reduced-motion setup skips the launch animation.
- Record local setup completion only after the worker accepts the successful setup state write.
- Preserve pending screen events when setup finishes and retry temporary local-worker connection failures, so a fast completion or a slow telemetry request does not lose the visit history.
- Pass a fresh setup-attempt ID through the existing installer pairing when telemetry is enabled, allowing the matching admin report to connect setup progress to the authorized account flow.

The events follow the existing analytics settings, including `DO_NOT_TRACK`. Their schema accepts only known screen IDs, actions, error codes, timestamps, and random attempt/visit IDs. Prompts, filenames, URLs, credentials, and free-form error text are excluded. Sample previews do not emit setup events. The worker's long-lived anonymous identity is not aliased to an account.

Per-screen history starts with this release. Older installers did not record these screens, so their missing events are not treated as zero conversions or abandonment.

## Runtime fixes included since v15.10.1

- Stop replaying stale local observer work after quota or authentication recovery. Live capture uses a bounded handoff; pending inputs expire after five minutes and are discarded on quota/authentication failure. Saved memories and original transcripts remain intact. Capture skipped during an outage is not automatically backfilled.
- Restore the server viewer's read endpoints using the server's Postgres data and existing team/project authorization. Shared server log files remain unavailable to tenant keys.
- Stop advertising `dumb_search` on the server runtime, where only the local worker can execute it.
- Derive the default worker port per installation to avoid local port collisions while preserving the legacy Windows server port.
- Show files outside a project under the home directory as `~/…` in generated context, rather than long chains of parent-directory segments.
- Prefer the configured provider's agent for My Work refreshes.

Full comparison: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.10.1...v15.11.0

## First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support `--channel`. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against `SHA256SUMS`, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable `jcode` on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted `.exe`.

From that preview binary, run `jcode update --channel preview` (substitute its full path for `jcode`) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with `update --channel stable`, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the `v1.0.0` stable tag is created.

body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ts): read each leaf line in leafNonEnglish by @sathariels in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1450

* fix(laya-ts): read maxLoaded as int() does, so an unreadable cap cannot disable eviction by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1457
* fix(batch): refuse a batch_size the chunker cannot spend by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1458
* fix(ts): bound the Router's own hooks with hooksTimeout, as Python does by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1459
* fix(ts): gate Router.predictBatch answers on minConfidence, as Python does by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1460

* test(hooks): check the closed coroutine by behaviour, not by getcoroutinestate by @ogmanojdev in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1462
* docs(contributing): say what the shared test list needs beyond the mcp extra by @ogmanojdev in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1463
* fix(integrations): refuse wide numeric answer fields by @mertkayacs in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1466
* perf(common): combine exact CPU attention windows and packed decision heads by @bahram-po in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1467
* fix(router): compose legacy batch keyword fallbacks by @GoldArowana in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1468

* @mertkayacs made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1466

name: v3.1.0
body:
## What's Changed Howdy! Today, I'm starting a new tradition for Harper. Instead of the bland, colorless release notes you've _been_ receiving for past releases, you'll now be getting these new, awesome release notes I type up myself. The hope is that by writing these notes directly, in addition to the updates on [my blog](https://elijahpotter.dev/), I can get closer to you guys, the people using Harper. I'll share some of the things on my mind, the places Harper is going, and the wonderful work Harper's community has gotten done since the last release. We have a ton of updates and bug fixes coming in this release. I'll cover some of my favorite changes, but I won't be able to cover everything. You can find a list of ALL the changes in the PR notes at the end. First off, we've simplified some parts of Harper's UI. In the desktop app, instead of seeing a green or red bar to signify if Harper is activated, you should see a dot below the Harper logo in the menu if the service is running. If the service is _not_ running, there's no dot. Simple enough. You'll also observe that the menu bar should look much nicer in both light and dark modes. In the Chrome Extension, we've reverted some of the changes from `v3.0.0` that made the popup menu (what you get when you click on the Harper logo) more "exciting". They were distracting and a little confusing, so we banished them. Secondly, I've done a ton of work fixing bugs in our support for Google Docs. You should now see correct behavior when Harper checks sentences that span multiple pages and tables should now play more nicely with suggestions. Plus, thanks to @mvanhorn, we have some improved support for editors like WordPress' Gutenberg. In the desktop app, we're pushing out some similar improvements. We got some reports that Harper didn't play well with setups with multiple monitors. It should be much cleaner now. We also got some feedback that the Desktop app was a little confusing. We heard similar feedback a while ago about the Chrome Extension, which we addressed with a tip system. We set a similar "tip" system up for the Desktop app. We shall see if it help make things a little less confusing. From now on, you'll occasionally see tips appear when you review a highlighted problem in your text. The most important changes, as always, were in our core grammar engine. We've added a ton of new rules and fixed a number of broken ones. Thanks to everyone who opened PRs in that vein, especially @hippietrail who's been reviewing them so prodigiously. I'll talk to you again in the next release! Thanks for using Harper. Have a great weekend. # Cua Driver 0.41.1

## Summary

This release includes 2 fixes.

## Fixes

- keep a session's last use on its lifecycle record. ([#6773](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/6773))

## Contributors

This release contains maintainer changes only.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on

# Cua Driver 0.40.5

## Summary

This release includes 2 fixes.

## Fixes

- refuse MCP requests before initialize on HTTP and envelope transports. ([#6743](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/6743))
- keep polling macOS grants after the permissions gate times out. ([#6739](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/6739))

## Contributors

This release contains maintainer changes only.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

# Cua Driver 0.40.1

## Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

## Fixes

- refuse disabled macOS controls on every token writer. ([#6503](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/6503))

## Contributors

This release contains maintainer changes only.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
